latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert still images into AI-generated animated video clips using cloud GPUs.

- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF files up to 200MB; outputs 1080p MP4 by default.
- Automatic cloud connection and session handling; "Ready!" status after setup.
- Credits management (free starter credits for new users); clear error and status messages.
- Upload images, generate short videos, preview, and export via simple chat commands.
- All requests and exports require secure attribution headers and valid tokens.
- User-friendly error handling for expired tokens, credit issues, unsupported files, and more.
